<article>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

            <h1>RabbitMQ Operator</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for RabbitMQ Operator</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for RabbitMQ Operator supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Redis Operator</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Redis Operator</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (7)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Redis Operator supports the following components.</p>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/redis-operator\/icons\/color\/redis-operator-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }
</script>

            <h1>Rook Ceph Cluster</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Rook Ceph Cluster</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Rook</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Rook</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Rook supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Rustrial Aws Eks Iam Auth Controller</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Rustrial Aws Eks Iam Auth Controller</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Rustrial Aws Eks Iam Auth Controller supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/rustrial-aws-eks-iam-auth-controller/components/iam-identity-mapping/icons/color/iam-identity-mapping-color.svg"
                        alt="iam-identity-mapping"
                        onerror="handleImageError(this)"
                        data-logo-for-dark="/content/en/extensions/models/rustrial-aws-eks-iam-auth-controller/components/iam-identity-mapping/icons/white/iam-identity-mapping-white.svg"
                        data-logo-for-light="/content/en/extensions/models/rustrial-aws-eks-iam-auth-controller/components/iam-identity-mapping/icons/color/iam-identity-mapping-color.svg" />
                </div>
                <p class="Compitems">iam-identity-mapping</p>
            </div>
            
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<article>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Schemahero</p>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<article>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Serverless Workflow</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Serverless Workflow</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Skooner</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Skooner</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

            <h1>Slack Operator</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Slack Operator</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Slack Operator supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/slack-operator\/icons\/color\/slack-operator-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }
</script>

            <h1>Bitwarden</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Bitwarden</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>SPIFFE</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for SPIFFE</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Stackgres Operator</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Stackgres Operator</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (15)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Stackgres Operator supports the following components.</p>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>
